# Move Back to Africa

> Move Back to Africa is a planning site for the African diaspora created by Ada Eguzouwa, a nurse-turned-agripreneur who builds businesses in Nigeria (Manna Farms, FarmLog, the Agribusiness Investors Club) and runs the personal brand Build With Ada. It helps the African diaspora plan a move or investment back home with free guides, a readiness quiz and practical workbooks.

## Guides
- [Moving Back to Africa: The 2026 Checklist](https://movebacktoafrica.com/guides/moving-back-to-africa-checklist.html): income, budget, land and trust, family, health, schooling, papers, ID and the first 30 days for diaspora returnees.
- [Free move-back readiness quiz](https://movebacktoafrica.com/quiz.html): 11 questions that score how ready someone is to move back to Africa.

## Products
- [How to Move Back to Africa: A Relocation Planning Workbook for the African Diaspora](https://stan.store/buildwithada): $37. A 55-question readiness checklist and nine worksheets covering income, monthly budget, property and trusted people, the family money talk, documents and national IDs for 21 African countries, a visit plan and a 90-day landing plan.
